resources.string: When each source was connected, Zankup brought its last 30 days. This asks Garmin and Google Health for the last year (in the background: it takes a few minutes) and reads it from Health Connect on this phone.
Under way: %1$s. The data will show up in Health as it arrives.
Reads sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, SpO₂, respiration and steps from Health Connect and sends them to your Zankup. Nothing is written to Health Connect.
Health Connect is not available on this phone.
Delete every sleep and daily figure from %1$s? It cannot be undone.

When several sources recorded the same thing, Zankup picks one automatically: for sleep the one with stages, for HRV the source of that night\'s sleep, for resting HR and steps the one worn longest. You can choose instead.
Not set up on this server (GOOGLE_HEALTH_ENABLED and a Google OAuth client).
Google stopped sharing the data: connect it again.
Some permissions were not granted, so part of the data is missing.
Connect Google Health from the web app; on this phone, Health Connect reads it directly.
Read from this phone: Health Connect, above.
No Garmin key: set GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY on the server.
